facts.text: Students apply directly to one of four undergraduate schools: Georgetown College, the Walsh School of Foreign Service, the McDonough School of Business, or the School of Nursing and Health Studies.

sources.title: Georgetown Undergraduate Admission
sources.quote: Applicants must select one of Georgetown’s four undergraduate schools when applying: Georgetown College, the School of Foreign Service, the McDonough School of Business, or the School of Nursing & Health Studies.
